## Mid-cycle performance (Typst / Mermaid / images)

Builds on **0.1.25** / tip `717da26`. Ships the measure-first perf work on main since that release.

### Heap / RSS
- **System fonts** — stop eagerly `read`ing every installed font into a `Vec` just to build `FontInfo` (~1GB+ on first Typst preview). Index from shared `fontdb` face metadata; `FontSlot` still loads a face once via `OnceLock` when Typst selects it (`4f12b94`).
- **Typst live sheets** — cap longest-edge display rasters at 2048px (same class as Mermaid). Large-page previews no longer spike ~78MiB RGBA / ~385MiB peak RSS; A4 stays on the uncapped path (`7f91d73`).

### Display rasters / caches
- **Mermaid** — reuse `SYSTEM_FONT_DB` instead of a second `load_system_fonts()` scan; cap sharp-view pixmap edge at 2048 (`4f12b94`).
- **Inline images** — real LRU for `data:` URL cache (64 entries / 32 MiB) (`4f12b94`).

### Diagnostics
- **`MALGEL_PERF=1`** — wall+RSS marks for fonts, compile, sheet, image file reads, first/warm preview apply; plus `samples/perf-preview` and `scripts/e2e/perf_startup.sh` (`7f91d73`).
